assumptions: TASK-003's shared TodoStoreRepository (src/store.js) does not exist on disk despite the task board marking TASK-003 done — the scope contract's allowed_file_substrate for this scope is limited to src/commands/done.js and its test, with no shared store module in scope, so load()/save() are implemented self-contained inside done.js (temp-file+rename write, ENOENT->empty list, JSON.parse/shape failure->StoreCorruptedError) directly against contracts/todo-store.contract.md rather than requiring a separate repository file.

done.js exports an async run(args, {cwd, stdout, stderr}) function rather than reading process.argv directly — argv routing/dispatch is explicitly Non-Go for this task (TASK-008), and no dispatcher exists yet to define a calling convention, so this shape lets a future bin/todo.js pass argv.slice(3) and injectable streams support deterministic testing without spawning a subprocess.

Confirmation message on success is 'Marked done: [<n>] <text>\n' to stdout — the use case's Output interface names id/text but ux-behavior.md does not pin an exact string, so this satisfies 'prints confirmation line' without inventing a format the spec constrains elsewhere.

MISSING_INDEX case (empty args) is validated and covered by a test for completeness (matches ux-behavior.md's Error Catalog and UC-CompleteTodo Step 2) even though it isn't itemized as a boundary-value AC in TASK-006's checklist.

STORE_CORRUPTED handling is implemented and tested (matches UC-CompleteTodo's Error Cases table and ux-behavior.md) even though it isn't itemized as a boundary-value AC in TASK-006's checklist, since 'validates ... BEFORE any store mutation' and the use case's Steps 3/STORE_CORRUPTED row imply it must not crash or corrupt further.
